"""End-to-end through the bounded child with a rule-heavy maximal job."""
import json, random, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import public_check

root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='e2e2-', dir='/workspace/tmp'))
frozen = root/'submission'
public_check.freeze(Path('/workspace/submission'), frozen)

rng = random.Random(4)
# 2 fields x K=1 with domains of size 256 -> U=65536; dense threshold predicates
dom = list(range(0, 256))
fields = [{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':dom}, {'name':'b','type':'count','domain':dom}]
preds = []
for i in range(32):
    f = fields[i % 2]
    cut = rng.randrange(0, 30)          # >= cut holds on ~90% of the domain
    preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,f['name']]},'op':'ge',
                  'right':{'const':cut,'type':f['type']}})
train = [[[rng.choice(dom), rng.choice(dom)]] for _ in range(2000)]
queries = [{'target':[0,'a' if i%2 else 'b'],'prefix':rng.choice(['','1','2','0','12','25','100','01']),
            'fixed':[{'ref':[0,'b' if i%2 else 'a'],'value':rng.choice(dom)}]} for i in range(64)]
job = {'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,
       'approved':[sorted(rng.sample(range(32), rng.randint(1,4))) for _ in range(256)],'queries':queries}
batch = {'jobs':[job]}
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data))
cwd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='case-', dir=root))
t = time.time()
out = public_check.capture(frozen/'main.py', data, cwd)
dt = time.time()-t
res = out['results'][0]
print('child wall %.2fs rules=%d active=%d answers=%d output=%.1fMiB'
      % (dt, len(res['rules']), len(res['active']), len(res['answers']), len(json.dumps(out))/1048576))
print('first rule', res['rules'][0] if res['rules'] else None)
print('last rule', res['rules'][-1] if res['rules'] else None)
# independent verification of the sorted order and certificates
prev = None
for r in res['rules']:
    key = (len(r['clause']), r['clause'])
    assert prev is None or prev < key, ('order', prev, key)
    prev = key
    assert len(r['clause']) == len(r['witnesses'])
    assert all(r['clause'][i] < r['clause'][i+1] for i in range(len(r['clause'])-1))
    assert 0 <= r['counterexample'] < 65536
print('rule ordering/shape verified')
import shutil; shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
PYEOF
